query: I just remembered something about my time at MyContext Systems. Add it to my context and connect it to the relevant project and role.
Please capture the important facts from my resume so I can use them in future sessions, keeping the resume as evidence.
What does my context say about examples of technical leadership, and which claims are actually supported by evidence?
I think one of my current goals may be stale. Review my personal context and show me what needs confirmation.
Can you reconcile these two pages in my Context Vault and preserve any uncertainty instead of choosing a version silently?
Based on my career context, gather the evidence I should give to a career advisor for a Staff Engineer discussion.
I copied an existing Context Vault into this checkout. Orient yourself from its schema, index, and recent log, then help me continue.
I want to move my personal context to another computer. Check that the vault remains portable and tell me what, if anything, needs attention.
Ingest this source but only ask me about claims that could materially affect future answers. Leave routine claims unconfirmed and tell me which current-state items need attention.
My current-role page may be stale. Check its freshness before using it in an answer and ask me one bounded question if it matters.
Before updating my Context Vault, create a local timestamped backup and keep only the latest three copies.
Write a generic resume summary for a fictional software engineer named John Doe. Do not use any personal files.
How should I organize a generic project-notes vault in Obsidian?
Review this public job description and list its required qualifications. It is not about my background.
What is the correct Git syntax for ignoring a directory named vault?
Design a database schema for storing generic employee profiles and career histories.
Draft a fictional interview story about an engineer resolving a production incident without reading my context.
Ingest John Doe's authored essay as Writing evidence, compare its communication patterns with the existing profile, and tell me if anything meaningfully changed.
Add John Doe's human-edited revision of an AI draft to his Writing context without treating the generated draft as evidence.
Review whether John Doe's writing pattern is global or only true in technical articles, and preserve contradictory opinion-essay evidence.
Why did SelfContext make no meaningful Writing profile update after analyzing John Doe's new article? Explain the evidence comparison.
What does John Doe's Writing context say about how he explains complex ideas to readers, and which sources support it?
Update John Doe's Writing profile to represent how his introductions changed over time, keeping the older evidence visible.
Separate John Doe's explicit preference for direct language from the opinions expressed in his essays when ingesting this source.
Use John Doe's Writing context and his MyContext Systems career project page to help outline a technical article without duplicating either domain.
What do I already understand about distributed systems, and which parts are demonstrated versus only familiar?
Capture this meaningful Learning gap about concurrent rendering without treating one question as proof of incompetence.
Explain monads using concepts that my Context Vault supports as known prerequisites.
I corrected a misconception about closures. Preserve the old and new models and the evidence for the change.
Have I changed my understanding of microservices over time? Use dated Learning evidence.
Did completing this course prove that I understand functional programming? Check my evidence instead of assuming it did.
Use a Career project as evidence for what I know, but keep the professional record in Career.
What should I learn before category theory given the concepts already in my vault?
Write a generic blog post about queues for a fictional audience; do not read any personal files or create a Context Vault.
Proofread this public article for spelling only. It is not mine and I do not want personal context used.
Summarize a company's public writing guidelines without relating them to my communication patterns.
Explain how to configure a Markdown linter for a generic documentation repository.
Retrieve the employer listed in my career vault; do not analyze my writing or give advice.
Design a generic database schema for storing authors and articles, unrelated to my Context Vault.
Who is Alice in my context, how do I know her, and what did we last discuss?
Did I promise Martín I would send the repository, or was it just a vague plan?
Give me useful context before I meet Sarah tomorrow, but do not make a dossier about her.
Record this meaningful interaction and preserve the reported statement without saving the whole chat.
What kinds of games do I consistently enjoy, and which reactions support that pattern?
Would I probably like this film given my actual media history and its heavy combat?
I loved this exception even though I usually dislike musicals. Keep that nuance in my taste context.
Has my taste changed over time, or is this just a different medium? Use dated evidence.
Build a CRM from every person in my inbox and rank them by relationship strength.
Track every Spotify play and make a complete Letterboxd-style media database.
Infer my colleague's diagnosis and political beliefs from their messages.
Summarize a movie's plot and cast for my film club without using my context.
Run a deep lint of my Context Vault and show deterministic maintenance findings.
Deep-review my vault read-only; do not create a backup or report.
I explicitly authorize a deep update after you compare the snapshot with the reviewed plan.
Assess whether my vault should adopt the Learning vertical without creating it yet.
Adopt the Media / Taste vertical and migrate only clearly owned existing pages.
Review my vault against the new Writing contract and tell me whether any evidence is affected.
Update my Career vertical contract using only documented migrations.
Migrate my legacy schema 0.1 vault to schema 0.2, preserving custom areas and pages.
Make a small task context packet for my interview using only relevant career evidence and constraints.
Search my large Context Vault locally for the exact project alias, then inspect provenance before answering.
Synchronize the managed index catalogs without changing manual text outside the markers.
Why is my current role stale? Do a targeted review, not a full-vault deep review.
Write a generic database-backed knowledge base with vector search.
Start a background agent to maintain my notes continuously.
Enrich every book page from the web and build a recommendation database.
Give my vault a single numeric health score.
Create every available vertical directory even though my vault has no evidence for them.
Use embeddings and MCP to retrieve all of my personal context.
Rewrite my entire vault into a generic wiki with one page per concept.
Confirm all unverified pages automatically because the model is confident.
Make a career task context packet using Career and Writing, excluding unrelated relationship details.
Explain this concept from demonstrated prerequisites in my Learning context as a task packet.
Create a task packet that keeps stale decisive context visible instead of treating it as current.
Keep this useful task packet ephemeral; do not save it as derived context.
Retain this reusable task context packet as a linked derived synthesis.
Make a generic project brief from fictional data without using my vault.
